description: §19.16.2 (S430 round 6) — a `defer` that is the whole UNBRACED body of an `if` (a), an `else` (b) or a loop (l) is E-DEFER-UNSUPPORTED-SITE — three occurrences. For `else` this is load-bearing: the live front-end drops an unbraced `else` arm (a separate gap), which would otherwise attach the defer to the function block and run it whether or not `c` holds.
rationale: §19.16.2: the unbraced body of an if / else / for / while / do arm is not a stage-1 defer site; it SHALL be a compile error, never silently mis-scoped.
